articles.title: PNC Financial Expands Colorado, Arizona Reach With FirstBank Buyout
articles.mainIdea: PNC Financial Expands Colorado, Arizona Reach With FirstBank Buyout
articles.summary: Zacks: PNC Financial Expands Colorado, Arizona Reach With FirstBank Buyout. PNC completes its $4.1B FirstBank acquisition, boosting scale in Colorado and Arizona and setting a 2026 customer conversion timeline. Related tickers mentioned: PNFP, PNFP-PA, PNFP-PB, PNFP-PC.
